evals.prompt: Use $webnovel-review to review chapter 4 in full mode.
expectations: binds prepare and accept to the same host-provided CODEX_THREAD_ID UUID
uses the managed webnovel_reviewer child Agent
requires explicit Codex rollout identity for gpt-5.6-luna high
persists one run-specific result, metrics file, report, and matching database row
does not write a global previous-chapter tmp artifact

evals.prompt: Review chapter 5, but do not choose a blocking resolution yet.
expectations: returns exactly targeted_fix, report_only, and abandon
binds the options to an exact assistant marker and reads the real user answer from a trusted parent rollout receipt matching both prepare-time CODEX_THREAD_ID and reviewer child evidence
rejects caller-supplied choice fields, wrong-parent receipts, stale receipts, and replayed receipts
does not create a public report or review_metrics row before a choice

evals.prompt: Review chapters 6 through 10 and resume after a simulated database-busy failure.
expectations: accepts five chapters and rejects six
runs one reviewer at a time
stops at the first blocker or failure until a scoped trusted parent-rollout decision
resumes database persistence without rerunning the accepted reviewer
